summary: Thunk wrapper (stdcall) that forwards the hostshort argument unchanged to the imported Windows API htons (bound at __imp_htons) and returns its result. Acts as a byte-swapping entry used by socket/network code.

operations.description: Forward hostshort to the imported htons entry point stored at __imp_htons and use the returned value as this function's result.
This thunk is reached from the network/socket paths sub_562010, sub_562D90, sub_5630D0 and sub_563AB0, which use it to convert host-order values.

unresolved: The import address __imp_htons is resolved at load time by the loader; which winsock/network library supplies it is outside this function.
The precise network context (raw socket vs. protocol message header) in each caller is not recoverable from this packet.
